scripts.build: npm run build --prefix "pinverse-platform (sass)" && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const s=p.join('pinverse-platform (sass)','.next');if(fs.existsSync('.next'))fs.rmSync('.next',{recursive:true});fs.cpSync(s,'.next',{recursive:true});console.log('Copied .next to root')"
